candidate_evidence_admission_result.expected: After an accepted SourceExcerpt candidate is projected, mutate the persisted SourceAnchor hash or byte range from the real admission authorization callback. The callback must revalidate the candidate-specific SourceAnchor descriptor inside the admission transaction, return content-dark Refused, consume exactly the reserved call, persist one zero-delta Refused receipt, and persist no result rows, Documents, or returned bytes.
candidate_evidence_admission_result.timing_proof: The fixture arms the server-owned IRepositoryAuthorizationVerifier after handle issuance and skips the initial authority and operation-level revalidation checks; the mutation fires only on the third authorization check, which is the PreparedPass2Store admission callback after ExecuteAsync has returned the candidate. The test asserts the mutation hook ran and the source reader was called once.
candidate_evidence_admission_result.causal_red: The pre-correction production admission callback revalidated only pair/job/Flow Group/document authority and live repository access. It did not inspect each candidate item’s current SourceAnchor hash or byte range, so the mutated accepted candidate was admitted instead of Refused.
